# Xiaoqi Desk Pet
Xiaoqi is a companion for DeepSeek Harness with two surfaces:

- a frame-wide pet inside the DSH Web UI (all platforms), and
- an always-on-top desktop pet outside

the Harness window:
- macOS: native Swift app,
- Windows/Linux: Electron companion (source and buil
d scripts included).
Both read the same live session state. The native pet is a separate always-on-top, transparent windo
w; drag it anywhere and pin it. When it connects, the in-page pet hides so you do not see two Xiaoqi
s. Quit the native app and the in-page pet comes back.
## What it does
- **One pet, every session.** The board groups sessions into *Needs you*, *In progress*, and *Just f

inished*, with title, project folder, status, and update time.
- **Task-name bubble for one task.**
With a single active session, a compact bubble under the pet begins with the task name and shows the

current action and elapsed time.
- **Color-coded task drawers for several tasks.** With two or more
active sessions, the bottom bubble disappears and one drawer card per task fans out beside the pet.
Each task keeps a stable, distinct color. Cards show the checklist item or action, elapsed time and

recent trail; clicking a card brings DSH forward and opens that exact session.
- **Account balance
on the belly.** The signed-in DSH account wallet balance (recharge + bonus) appears as a compact bad
ge on the pet's belly even when there are no tasks, and refreshes about once a minute; it is hidden

when signed out. Right-click the in-page pet to close it; it returns on the next page load.
- **Bord
ered, color-coded task cards.** Inside the board every task is its own card with a thin border, a ti

nted surface and its own stable color—so several tasks never blur into one list.
- **Task-specific p
rogress while you are elsewhere.** The board shows the current checklist item, the concrete action i
n flight (for example `修改 client.js`, `运行：Build the macOS app`, `读取 README.md`), elapsed time, and t

he last three actions. The native pet's caption follows the current task or action.
- **Live, not po
lled.** The in-page board reads the Session list and status snapshots supplied to the `shell.overlay

` slot. The native app polls the token-protected local bridge every 1.2 seconds.
- **Speaks up.** A
new approval, question, plan review, or a session finishing in the background raises a notice. In th

e native app the notice is a separate non-blocking desktop bubble.
- **Drag and pin.** Move the pet
anywhere; pin the position. The in-page pet uses viewport-relative coordinates and the native app us

es screen coordinates, both persisted locally.
- **Open the exact session.** Clicking a task row on
the native board queues an open-session command for DSH and brings Harness to the front. The in-page

row opens it directly.
- **English and Chinese**, light and dark system appearance, original SVG ar
twork, no external images or fonts.
No message content is read for the board. The bridge transfers session titles, project folder names,
checklist text, tool/action labels, and derived timing facts only.

## Install the desktop pet
### macOS native app
Requires macOS 13 or later and Xcode command-line tools.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The app is a menu-bar accessory (`LSUIElement`) with no Dock icon. Its paw menu offers show/hide, pi
n, open board, reconnect, and quit.
If the native app is not running, the in-page board's monitor button tries to launch it from `~/Appl
ications/Xiaoqi Pet.app` or `/Applications/Xiaoqi Pet.app`.
See desktop/README.md for build details and the local bridge contract.
### Windows / Linux Electron companion
The cross-platform companion lives in `desktop/electron`. It reads the same bridge, shows the same t
ask colors, and uses the same click-to-open flow.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Build artifacts:

See desktop/electron/README.md. The Windows/Linux packages are configured but have not been run on t
hose operating systems in this environment; build and verify them on each target OS before calling t
tems in this environment; build and verify them on each target OS before calling them release-ready.
## What "pinned" means
- **In-page pet:** a frame-wide overlay inside the DSH Web UI. It stays above the sidebar, conversat

ion, and composer, and remembers its viewport-relative position.
- **Native pet:** a separate border
less `NSPanel` at the floating window level, with `.canJoinAllSpaces` and `.fullScreenAuxiliary`. It
is always-on-top across Spaces and can be placed anywhere on the desktop, including outside the Har
n-top across Spaces and can be placed anywhere on the desktop, including outside the Harness window.
## Compatibility

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.1` through `0.2.1-rc.3`
- Chromium-based DSH Web UI for the in-page pet
- macOS 13+

for the Swift pet
- Windows/Linux for the Electron companion
- No runtime dependencies, no install s
cripts, no outbound network calls
## Development
The bundle is plain JavaScript: `index.js` is the Host half (bridge, session progress, local command
queue), and `client.js` is the Web module registered in `shell.overlay`.
